question.text: Un-invested portion of investable funds in a Cat III AIF can temporarily be parked in:

answer.text: Liquid mutual funds, bank deposits, T-bills, CPs, CDs, TREPS

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.4, un-invested portions go into liquid MF, bank deposits, T-bills, TREPS, CPs, CDs. The Trap: Equity derivatives/real estate/gold are not permissible for short-term parking. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in XIX-A (Cat I/II). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track the parking yield — unoptimized idle cash drags overall IRR.
